caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a rectangular room with wooden beams and paneling, primarily colored in shades of brown, green, and beige. The floor is green and the woodwork is painted brown. The ceiling is also brown with visible wooden beams. On the left side, there is a doorway with yellow light shining from the adjacent space, showing a staircase beyond. Near the center of the far wall is a red brick fireplace with a lit fire, a black kettle hanging above the flames, and various blue, white, and brown vases placed on its mantel. On the right side of the fireplace, a set of windows with white curtains and red and white laundry hung on a line just below them stretches along the side wall. The earrings wall has a wooden door with a shelf above it, upon which several bottles of different sizes and colors are arranged. On the far right, a broom leans against the wall. The left wall is mostly bare, showing cracked plaster, while the right wall has a framed picture hung at an angle with a blue ribbon or string. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the fireplace and door roughly aligned in the center of the image.
title: Backdrop for Puppet Show
